description: Consumer Affair's Authority - The Maximum Retail Price for Eggs
categorisation: This gazette content is an order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under Section 20(5) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, setting maximum retail prices for eggs. It constitutes a regulatory measure and falls under the category of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5), which includes "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation." The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
